title: IML BeeSenses: flowers as honeybees see them, for A Gift For People With Fear Of Honeybees
description:
IML BeeSenses shows flowers as honeybees see them. From an ordinary photo, a ComfyUI node pack works out the ultraviolet, the bee's own colours, each bee receptor, a bee colour map, a bee's-eye view and an infrared estimate, then turns each view into a height map, a 3D relief mesh, a Gaussian splat and a short animation. Where a species' petal reflectance has been measured, the UV comes from that measured spectrum.

It is part of A Gift For People With Fear Of Honeybees, a gentle, step-by-step garden for people with a mild fear of honeybees, made for the Jupiter SR glasses-free 3D screen and VR headsets. Seeing through a bee's eyes is the reward at the end. The garden is for mild fear only and is not a clinical treatment.

A Gift For People With Fear Of Honeybees is a separate app by Hope Abeacan. It is not included in this record, is not covered by its licences, and all rights are reserved.

This version holds the project notes: the project summary, the modelling record and the bee garden findings. The node pack code and the open flower library (Gaussian splat blooms, bee views and plant data) will follow in later versions.
